SELECT ci.id, ci.cart_id, c.cart_code, c.status AS cart_status, ci.product_code, ci.product_model, ci.sort_order, ci.batch_no, ci.layer_no, ci.operator, ci.status, ci.loaded_at, ci.taken_at, ci.remark, su1.nickname AS created_by_name, ci.created_time, su2.nickname AS updated_by_name, ci.updated_time FROM wms_cart_item ci LEFT JOIN wms_cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON ci.created_by = su1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON ci.updated_by = su2.id
AND ci.cart_id = #{query.cartId}
AND c.cart_code LIKE '%' || #{query.cartCode} || '%'
AND ci.product_code LIKE '%' || #{query.productCode} || '%'
AND ci.product_model LIKE '%' || #{query.productModel} || '%'
AND ci.batch_no LIKE '%' || #{query.batchNo} || '%'
AND ci.status = #{query.status}
AND ci.layer_no = #{query.layerNo}
AND ci.operator LIKE '%' || #{query.operator} || '%'
AND ci.loaded_at >= #{query.loadedAtStart}::timestamp
AND ci.loaded_at <= #{query.loadedAtEnd}::timestamp
AND (ci.product_code LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR ci.product_model LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%' OR ci.batch_no LIKE '%' || #{query.keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY ci.loaded_at DESC, ci.sort_order DESC

SELECT ci.id, ci.cart_id, c.cart_code, c.status AS cart_status, ci.product_code, ci.product_model, ci.sort_order, ci.batch_no, ci.layer_no, ci.operator, ci.status, ci.loaded_at, ci.taken_at, ci.remark, su1.nickname AS created_by_name, ci.created_time, su2.nickname AS updated_by_name, ci.updated_time FROM wms_cart_item ci LEFT JOIN wms_cart c ON ci.cart_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON ci.created_by = su1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON ci.updated_by = su2.id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.sort_order DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ci.sort_order), 0) FROM wms_cart_item ci WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} AND ci.status = 1
